Pelican Town has a lot to offer already, and Cindersnap Forest is no different! Explore a new area full of New Characters in Cindersnap Circle! Located North of Marnie's farm, Cindersnap Circle is a cozy spot where a few of Pelican Town's residents have settled down. [/center]

[color=#cfe2f3][size=3][b]Notes: [/b][/size][/color]
﻿- To get to Cindersnap Circle, follow the staircase just West of Marnie's farm OR use the signs near Marnie's farm and at the bus stop!



[b][font=Georgia][color=#f4cccc][size=5][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/77005953-1727469492.png[/img]﻿[/center][/size][/color][/font][/b][left][font=Georgia][color=#cfe2f3][size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/77005953-1693342154.png[/img]﻿
﻿﻿﻿[/size][/color][/font][/left][center][font=Arial]Say 'Hello' to Pelican Town's resident [color=#f1c232]R&B musician[/color] and [color=#f1c232]fashion connoisseur[/color], Milo!

[color=#f1c232]He likes to think of himself as a laid-back and humorous kind of guy, but some days he can be pretty negative and hot-tempered.[/color] Despite living in Pelican Town for a few years now, he still feels like an outsider to the relaxed country life he's found himself in. Life moves so much slower than he's use to, and he's severely underestimated how many [i]bugs [/i]would invade his home in Cindersnap Circle. Still, he's given up the big city life for a reason, so he's determined to find his place in the town while also continuing to produce his own music.

﻿Will Pelican Town's newest farmer be the friend he needed to become the person he wants to be? Or, could they be something more? Get to know Milo through his customized home and schedule, randomized dialogue options, and festival locations! [/font][/center]
[b][color=#ffd966]Milo Notes:
[/color][/b]
- Birthday: [color=#bf9000]Winter 22[/color]
- Loved Gifts: Maki Roll, Ice Cream, Wine, Stir Fry, and Peaches
- Liked Gifts: Cherries, Jack O' Lanterns, Midnight Squid, Fairy Roses, and Blue Jazz's
- Does NOT like bugs or tomatoes. (Seriously, he has enough bug meat on his shoes)
- Will have 10 heart events (WIP)**
[b]﻿- There are currently six heart events that are completed, but 8 and 10 are still incomplete!!![/b]
- There is a spouse room that should work, but I have only done limited testing!
- Has different schedules depending on the day and season.
[font=Georgia][color=#f4cccc][size=5][b]
[/b][/size][/color][/font][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/77005953-1693342110.png[/img]
﻿
[center][font=Arial][size=2]While Milo's experience in Zuzu City wasn't the best, he wasnever truly alone with his older brother Bryson around!

Despite his appearance, it's been a while since Bryson has truly had to act as
tough as he looks. [color=#6fa8dc]He's friendly, mischievous and a little messy if he's beinghonest, but as much as he jokes around, his heart is in the right place when it
matters.[/color] After their sudden move to Pelican Town, Bryson has a lot more time topursue his creative side, and has since become enamored with the world of
fashion. His style is his own and most days he's content to spend some time
working on his designs. When he isn't working on his designs, he's often spending
time with his best friend, Dimitri. Between the two of them, there's always
mischief and plenty of humor to go around. Still, there are things from his
past that weigh him down even now, and things he avoids talking about through
his sense of humor and unbothered attitude. 
Maybe a new friend is what he needs to confront the person he was in Zuzu City.
Maybe something more?[/size][/font][/center]


[b][color=#cfe2f3]Bryson Notes:
[/color][/b]
- Birthday: [color=#6d9eeb]Fall 14[/color]
- Loved Gifts: Jade Strawberries, Pepper Poppers, Rainbow Shells, Cloth, Pink Cake
- Liked Gifts: Wool, Fire Quartz, Amethyst, Ghostfish, Sashimi, emerald, Coffee
- Disliked Gifts: Beer, Pizza, Clay, Ice Cream, Garlic
- Hated Gifts: Wine, Joja Coloa, Fried Eggs, Omelets, and Grapes
- Has different schedules depending on the day and season.
- [color=#6fa8dc]Now Available for Marriage![/color]
- There are currently no heart events with Bryson.


[b][font=Georgia][color=#c9daf8][size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/77005953-1693342188.png[/img]
[/size][/color][/font][/b]
[center][font=Arial]Pelican Town is home to monsters and magic of all sorts, and Dimitri is no stranger to either!

Having been dead for a few years already, Dimitri thinks he has a pretty good handle on things. [color=#c27ba0]He's still learning how to use his magic, but 
as long as he keeps healing and [i]FastFang[/i] keeps his fridge stocked with artificial blood, he's not too worried about his new life...or afterlife?[/color] Undead existence?
Looking for adventure keeps him busy when he's not up to no good with Bryson, but there are still times where he misses not having to use expensive sunscreen to feel the sun on his skin. Not being able to eat his favorite foods is also a massive bummer, but he's not the type to focus on the negative...or acknowledge it much at all. That being said, a new farmer moving into town may be the perfect addition to his constant desire to experience new things.
The question is: can they keep up with him?[/font][/center]

[b][color=#d9d2e9]Dimitri Notes:[/color]
[/b]
- Birthday: [color=#c27ba0]Summer 6[/color]
- Loved Gifts: Ruby, Elvish Jewelry, Bomb, Obsidian, Jack O' Lanterns
- Liked Gifts: Amethys, Frozen Tear, Torch, Ghostfish, Cherry Bomb, Strawberry
- Disliked Gifts: Any Ingredients, Any vegetables or fruits, any artisan goods
- Hated Gifts: Oil of Garlic, Garlic, any cooking (He can't eat!)
- Has different schedules depending on the day and season.
- [color=#c27ba0]Now available for marriage![/color]
- No heart events yet!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/77005953-1695416171.png[/img]
[center]﻿Fairies aren't so rare in Pelican Town anymore ever since Faye's family opened up the Faerie Cafe!

If someone told Faye that her father, the king of the fairies, would uproot their entire family and force them to live in a backwards human town,
she would have very likely had them excecuted. [color=#ea9999]Accustomed to a life of luxury and magic, it's safe to say that she was NOT happy to be dragged
across realms to settle in Pelican Town of all places[/color]. Unfortunately for her, both her father and her sister are the sentimental type and 
Pelican Town is where her father met her human mother. Faye always felt as though she was never her mother's favorite, and that 
Fiyona's obsession with humanity gave her the upper hand when it came to a maternal connection. Now, away from the fairy realm
and every luxury she grew up in the presence of, it's safe to say that she's got a bit of an attitude problem. She just barely tolerates
the human duo Skye and Milo, so she certainly couldn't care less about the new farmer down the street.

Still, it could never hurt to have an admirer right?
Maybe even a new friend if they prove to be less irritating than the vampire thief in her neighborhood.[/center]
[size=3][b]

[/b][/size]

[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/77005953-1706397671.png[/img][/b]
[center]After years of midterms and group projects in botanical science, Pelican Town can finally say "Hello" to Skye,
brand new owner of Cindersap's herbal remedy shop!

Skye has always had an interest in biological sciences, but an environmental science course and an aunt in Pelican town steer him 
away from a career in biochemical engineering and towards an apprenticeship in his aunt's local shop. Unfortunately, his aunt has a very different 
definition of "apprenticeship" and leaves him to take over the shop entirely while she travels the world in search of a magical herb capable of limitless power!
[color=#93c47d]Despite the change of plans, Skye is determined to make things work and to prove to his parents that he did NOT waste his education 
just to sit in Pelican Town and mix "fake medicine."[/color] He's proud of his craft, and proud of all the work he did to get there. And sure, he may 
be a bit spacey, but he is [color=#6aa84f][b]NOT[/b][/color] dumb!!! With the help of his business savvy friend Faye and a sometimes-helpful Milo, Skye
knows that his aunt's shop has been left in good hands. 

A new farmer means new business and possibly a new confidant for an overwhelmed college graduate trying to get through the day 
in his new small business owner lifestyle...and maybe someone to share in his addiction to boba tea. [/center]

[b][color=#cfe2f3]Installation:[/color]
[/b]- In﻿stall SMAPi and Content Patcher
- Download and extract the [CP]Cindersnap Circle and [CP] NPC folders into your Mods folder
- Enjoy!

[b][color=#cfe2f3]Requirements:[/color][/b]
- Requires SMAPI, Content Patcher and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10448]Lumisteria Tilesheets Outdoor[/url] to run
- In order to add NPC's, you must download the optional NPC files.
[color=#cfe2f3]﻿[b]Compatibility:[/b][/color]
- This mod should work with other map-editing and NPC mods as long as the area directly above Marnie's barn is untouched. 
- Do not download these mod files, and the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10359]original separate Milo file[/url], as they are incompatible and will break your game more than likely. 
- There is a SDVE patch included in the main file now. The optional file is made without any paths to prevent incompatibility issues.
- Currently Cindersnap Circle still does not appear on the map, but the NPC locations should show up in that general area of the forest. 
- Let me know if there are any issues!

[b][color=#cfe2f3]Known Issues:[/color] 
[/b]- I know it's annoying having multiple files for each NPC but doing it this way keeps things less confusing and easy to collaborate on with others. In the future they will all be merged into one. 
- Milo is the furthest along, and has the most content as of right now.
﻿- Many heart events are NOT FINISHED
﻿- Faye's schedule conflicts with Ridgeside village's NPC named Faye.
﻿- Right now, Dimitri, Milo, and Bryson are able to be married.
- On maps that have already been created, there may be bushes spawned in the path to the stairs, but they should not interfere with being able to get into     Cindersnap Circle.
